gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha has wide-mouthed curves and big lowercase. Revalia sits above it with a loud display swagger and loosely spaced letters, so the two feel like a shout followed by a friendly, easy answer.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Revalia's lowercase g leaves its lower curve wide open, giving the heading a relaxed, showy stride. Noto Sans Limbu follows with gaping curves and generous small letters, so paragraphs underneath feel approachable and modern rather than competing for attention.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Revalia strides along with widely separated letters and a bold, showy attitude. Noto Sans Lydian settles beside it with capitals barely taller than its lowercase and wide-open curves, which makes the two feel like a performer and a friendly bystander.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Loud, loose and unmistakably display. Noto Sans Mahajani gives that swagger a counterweight, its lowercase standing high against the capitals and its e opening like a funnel, which is easily the pair's strongest quality: a modern, plain sans that stays readable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numera: Revalia opens with bold, expressive lettering and a relaxed, widely spaced stride. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals follows with high-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c, so the heading gets to perform while the text stays crisp and contemporary.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Revalia brings bold, expressive display letters, spaced out in a relaxed stride with a g left open at the bottom. Noto Sans Medefaidrin takes over below with lowercase that rises high and curves that never clog, giving the page a crisp, contemporary footing.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Revalia hits with bold, expressive display letters, a g left open at the bottom and a relaxed, widely spaced stride. Its strength is attitude against ease.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikaku: Modern and clean describes the body, but Revalia is the showman, loud and loosely spaced where it counts. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui does the quieter job well, letting daylight through every curve while its lowercase stands high against the capitals.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Noto Sans Meroitic keeps its c openings see-through and its lowercase sturdy like capitals. Revalia above it is the bold, widely spaced show, so a modest body size beside the heading should let the friendlier sans breathe.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mro: Revalia's open-bottomed g gives its bold letters a relaxed, expressive swing. Noto Sans Mro follows with dense, high-set words and big entrances into each letter, so paragraphs feel modern and businesslike under that showy heading.
